deploy:all: flutter build web --release && npm run vercel:deploy
vercel:deploy: npm run vercel:prepare && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),os=require('os'),{execSync}=require('child_process'); const tmp=path.join(os.tmpdir(),'mleko-vercel-deploy'); fs.rmSync(tmp,{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync('build/vercel-deploy',tmp,{recursive:true}); execSync('npx vercel link --cwd \"' + tmp + '\" --yes --scope vrvladas-projects --project mleko', {stdio:'inherit'}); execSync('npx vercel deploy --cwd \"' + tmp + '\" --prod --yes --scope vrvladas-projects', {stdio:'inherit'});"
